description: Our real photo looks for one garment, model shots first, with the colors each has. For "a model wearing it": get_mockup with look set to the model look modelLookFor names for that color. The client shows these pictures to the person: refer to each by its label, and never write a preview link as a markdown image. Give it as a plain link only if the person asks to open or download it, or can't see it, and do not generate, draw or edit your own version of the shirt, design or product.
